# civ4-debug-tools test fixtures Index

## Files in This Directory

- **[build_small.sh](./build_small.sh)** - Script that rebuilds the fixture DLL and PDB from small.c

- **[small.pdb](./small.pdb)** - Fixture PDB (binary)
